2. ESTABLISH – NO STOPPING EXCEPT BICYCLES
ESTABLISH – BIKE SHARE STATION
Fillmore Street, east side along median, from Jefferson Street to 53 feet southerly
(bike share station in angled parking stalls)
(Supervisor District 2) Laura Stonehill, [staff email removed — see the order]

Proposing a Bay Wheels bike share station in the angled parking lane along the median on Fillmore
Street.

Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer for implementation.
Public Comments: Received comments in support and opposition.
